decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The tree works shall comprise only the following and must be carried out in accordance with British Standard BS3998:2010:

- Felling of 1no. Lime tree (T1) in the front garden subject to Tree Preservation Order TPO/141/10/86. 

To ensure that the authorised works are carried out in accordance with good arboricultural practice and in the interests of visual amenity and the character and appearance of the conservation area, in accordance with Policies OS5 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 2 - No less than five working days' notice shall be given to the Council's Aboricultural Officer before any work commences to the tree (Telephone 020 8748 3020). 

In order that the Council has the opportunity to ensure that the work is carried out in accordance with Condition 1, in accordance with Policies DC8 and OS5 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 3 - Prior to the felling of the tree hereby approved, details of the replacement tree (including species, height, maturity, and location) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The replacement tree shall be planted in accordance with the approved details within the next available planting season after the felling of the tree. If the replacement tree is severely damaged, dying, or seriously diseased within 5 years of planting, it shall be replaced with a tree of similar size and species in the next appropriate planting season.

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC8 and OS5 of the Local Plan (2018).
description: Felling of a Lime tree (T1) in the front garden, subject to Tree Preservation Order TPO/141/10/86.
